newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: EIGHT FIRMS COMPETE FOR SLOVENIA GAS STATION SITES.
newsitem.headline: EIGHT FIRMS COMPETE FOR SLOVENIA GAS STATION SITES.

text.p: LJUBLJANA, Nov 25 (Platt's) - Eight oil companies are competing for the first batch of 13 gas station sites along Slovenia's new expressways, officials said on Monday.
Shell Slovenia is reportedly seeking six sites, Italy's Agip up to 10, Hungaqry's MOL has entered an undisclosed number of bids, as has Eurest amd Croatian Interina.
Austria's OMV is involved through its joint venture with the local company Istrabenz. Wholly-domestic Petrol is reported to have entered bids for all 13 stations.

Bids were officially opened mid-October and the national expressway builder/operator DARS is scheduled to announce final choices in the first week of December. DARS is planning to award 30-year concessions for 44 gas stations.
At present only Petrol, Interina, OMV-Istrabenz operate gas stations in Slovenia.
